sentences.en: My father spends a lot of time on his hobby.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸花很多时间在自己的爱好上。

sentences.en: Hobbies take your mind off the worries of everyday life.
sentences.zh: 业余爱好能让你暂时忘掉日常生活中的烦恼。

sentences.en: We have many things in common: hobbies, educational backgrounds, for instance.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多共同点：比如爱好、教育背景等。

senses.zh: 业余爱好,嗜好，兴趣,小马
